description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class that handles exporting book data for the current user. It defines an API endpoint at /api/export-books-data which, upon HTTP GET request, retrieves the current user via UserService and delegates the data export to BookExportService, returning an ExportDto object.

classes.name: BookExportController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for exporting user's book data via GET API.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export the current user's book data, delegating to BookExportService.
